name: gridkit-studio
description: Explore, edit, and simulate power-system cases with native VS Code tools and Latkit.
author: Luke Lowery

scripts.quality: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm settings:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.bench:gate: pnpm bench && node tests/benchmarks/gate.mjs output/bench/base.json output/bench/head.json

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Inspect and edit cases. Simulation requires Workspace Trust.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Inspect and edit cases. Simulation requires a local filesystem on the workspace host.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open a GridKit case to explore its network, controls, and signals.
[Open Case](command:gridkitStudio.openCase)
Open a GridKit case to choose what its runs record.

case.description: Case path relative to the workspace folder.

values.description: Current catalog simulation parameters; the same values as the Simulation form.

gridkitStudio.gridkitPath.markdownDescription: Where GridKit is installed, such as `/opt/gridkit`. Empty finds GridKit's programs on `PATH`, as a dev container or remote host with GridKit has it.

gridkitStudio.gridkitImage.markdownDescription: The container image GridKit runs from, in Docker or Podman, when GridKit is not installed where the workspace is. Pull it yourself first (`docker pull ghcr.io/lukelowry/gridkit:latest`): GridKit Studio never pulls images. Empty runs only an installed GridKit.

gridkitStudio.containerCli.markdownDescription: The container CLI that runs **GridKit Image**: `docker`, `podman`, or a path to either. Empty uses `docker`, else `podman`, on `PATH`.

gridkitStudio.navigateOnSelection.description: Reveal selections in the active canvas.

gridkitStudio.resultCacheMiB.description: Maximum result-window cache per extension window in MiB.

gridkitStudio.accessibility.motion.markdownDescription: Motion. Reduce camera animation and interface motion. System follows the device.

gridkitStudio.accessibility.contrast.markdownDescription: Contrast. Increase contrast for text, borders and controls. System follows the device.

gridkitStudio.network.markers.markdownDescription: Layers — Vertices. Off hides vertex labels too.

gridkitStudio.network.lines.markdownDescription: Layers — Edges. Off leaves the world’s borders drawn.

gridkitStudio.network.borders.markdownDescription: Layers — Borders. Draw coasts and country borders under a network on Earth.

gridkitStudio.network.poles.markdownDescription: Layers — Height poles. Draw stems from the ground up to raised vertices.

gridkitStudio.network.grid.markdownDescription: Layers — Grid. Draw lines of latitude and longitude.

gridkitStudio.network.earthAxis.markdownDescription: Layers — Earth axis. Draw the axis the globe turns on.

gridkitStudio.network.vertexRadiusPx.markdownDescription: Size — Vertex radius. Marker radius before a bound size scales it.

gridkitStudio.network.zScale.markdownDescription: Size — Height. Multiplies how high a bound height raises vertices.

gridkitStudio.network.dashPeriodPx.markdownDescription: Size — Dash period. Length of one dash on edges a field dashes.

gridkitStudio.network.pathWidthPx.markdownDescription: Size — Border width. Stroke width of coasts and country borders.

gridkitStudio.network.vertices.labels.markdownDescription: Labels — Vertex labels. Name each vertex beside its marker.

gridkitStudio.network.edges.labels.markdownDescription: Labels — Edge labels. Name each edge along its line.

gridkitStudio.network.labels.maxCount.markdownDescription: Labels — Most labels. Labels drawn per type before the rest are thinned.

gridkitStudio.network.labels.repeatSpaci.markdownDescription: Labels — Repeat spacing. Leave out a label repeating one placed this close, as for buses of one substation. 0 labels each.

gridkitStudio.network.textColor.markdownDescription: Labels — Color. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.network.daylight.markdownDescription: Lighting — Daylight. Light a network on Earth by where the sun is now.

gridkitStudio.network.nightFloor.markdownDescription: Lighting — Night floor. Brightness of the network on the night side.

gridkitStudio.network.surfaceNightFloor.markdownDescription: Lighting — Ground night floor. Brightness of the ground on the night side.

gridkitStudio.network.terminatorWidth.markdownDescription: Lighting — Terminator width. Softness of the edge between day and night.

gridkitStudio.network.selectedEnds.markdownDescription: Highlight — Selected edge ends. Halo the vertices a selected edge joins.

gridkitStudio.network.hoverEnds.markdownDescription: Highlight — Hovered edge ends. Halo the vertices a hovered edge joins.

gridkitStudio.network.hoverColor.markdownDescription: Highlight — Hover color. Its alpha is the halo’s opacity.. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.network.selectedColor.markdownDescription: Highlight — Selection color. Its alpha is the halo’s opacity.. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.network.colormap.markdownDescription: Color — Colormap. Ramp for fields bound to color.

gridkitStudio.network.vertexColor.markdownDescription: Color — Vertex color. Vertices while no field drives their color.. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.network.edgeColor.markdownDescription: Color — Edge color. Edges while no field drives their color.. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.network.background.markdownDescription: Color — Background. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.network.surfaceColor.markdownDescription: Color — Ground. The globe, and the ground under a tilted view.. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.network.gridColor.markdownDescription: Color — Grid color. Lines of latitude and longitude.. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.network.pathColor.markdownDescription: Color — Border color. Coasts and country borders.. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.network.camera.projection.markdownDescription: Camera — Projection. How a network first shows. Globe needs geography.

gridkitStudio.network.fitPitch.markdownDescription: Camera — Tilt. How far a tilted view leans from straight down.

gridkitStudio.network.fitBearing.markdownDescription: Camera — Bearing. Rotation a fitted view settles at.

gridkitStudio.network.orbitRate.markdownDescription: Camera — Rotation speed. Multiplies the auto-rotation of 12° a second.

gridkitStudio.network.animationMs.markdownDescription: Camera — Easing. Duration of camera moves.

gridkitStudio.network.fitPaddingPx.markdownDescription: Camera — Fit padding. Space kept around the network when it is fitted.

gridkitStudio.network.revealPaddingPx.markdownDescription: Camera — Reveal margin. How far inside the edge a located element must sit.

gridkitStudio.network.input.mode.markdownDescription: Interaction — Mode. Navigate moves the view; Inspect only selects.

gridkitStudio.network.input.wheel.markdownDescription: Interaction — Wheel zoom. When the wheel zooms the view.

gridkitStudio.network.input.keyboard.markdownDescription: Interaction — Keyboard. Pan, zoom and step through elements with the keys.

gridkitStudio.network.pickRadiusPx.markdownDescription: Interaction — Pick radius. How near the pointer must be to hover or select.

gridkitStudio.network.msaa.markdownDescription: Quality — Antialiasing. Smooths edges at some cost.

gridkitStudio.network.hover.markdownDescription: Quality — Hover search. Auto pauses it while the view moves or runs slow.

gridkitStudio.network.hoverBudgetMs.markdownDescription: Quality — Hover budget. Time a hover search may take per frame.

gridkitStudio.monitor.yAxis.label.markdownDescription: Plot — Value caption. Name the plotted field above the value axis.

gridkitStudio.monitor.background.markdownDescription: Plot — Background. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.monitor.axisColor.markdownDescription: Plot — Axis color. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.monitor.gridColor.markdownDescription: Plot — Grid color. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.monitor.xAxis.minSpacingPx.markdownDescription: Ticks — Time spacing. Least gap between time ticks.

gridkitStudio.monitor.yAxis.minSpacingPx.markdownDescription: Ticks — Value spacing. Least gap between value ticks.

gridkitStudio.monitor.yAxis.format.markdownDescription: Ticks — Value format. Auto writes very large and small values with exponents.

gridkitStudio.monitor.fontSizePx.markdownDescription: Text — Size. Axis text size. The margins around the plot grow with it.

gridkitStudio.monitor.textColor.markdownDescription: Text — Color. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.monitor.interpolation.markdownDescription: Lines — Interpolation. How a line joins one sample to the next.

gridkitStudio.monitor.traceColor.markdownDescription: Lines — Color. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.monitor.camera.fit.markdownDescription: Scale — Fit values. Keep the value axis fitted to the data in view.

gridkitStudio.monitor.domainPadding.markdownDescription: Scale — Value margin. Room above and below fitted data, as a share of its range.

gridkitStudio.monitor.animationMs.markdownDescription: Scale — Easing. Duration of axis moves.

gridkitStudio.monitor.unselectedAlpha.markdownDescription: Selection — Others’ opacity. Opacity of the other lines while one is selected.

gridkitStudio.monitor.selectedColor.markdownDescription: Selection — Selection color. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.monitor.cursorColor.markdownDescription: Selection — Playhead color. The line at the time on show.. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.monitor.input.mode.markdownDescription: Interaction — Mode. Navigate adds the Home key to fit the plot.

gridkitStudio.monitor.input.keyboard.markdownDescription: Interaction — Keyboard. Select and clear with the keys.

gridkitStudio.monitor.pickRadiusPx.markdownDescription: Interaction — Pick radius. How near the pointer must be to select a line.

gridkitStudio.monitor.msaa.markdownDescription: Quality — Antialiasing. Smooths lines. Changing it draws the history again.

gridkitStudio.monitor.hover.markdownDescription: Quality — Hover search. Looks for the reading under the pointer.

gridkitStudio.monitor.hoverBudgetMs.markdownDescription: Quality — Hover budget. Time a hover search may take per frame.

gridkitStudio.diagram.background.markdownDescription: Canvas — Background. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.diagram.gridPitch.markdownDescription: Canvas — Grid pitch. Grid spacing, which is also the snap and nudge step.

gridkitStudio.diagram.gridMinSpacingPx.markdownDescription: Canvas — Dot spacing. Dots thin out when closer than this on screen.

gridkitStudio.diagram.gridColor.markdownDescription: Canvas — Grid color. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.diagram.cornerRadius.markdownDescription: Blocks — Corner radius. Rounding of rounded blocks, groups, and wire bends.

gridkitStudio.diagram.vertexPadding.markdownDescription: Blocks — Padding. Space inside a block, and around a group.

gridkitStudio.diagram.labelPosition.markdownDescription: Blocks — Title. Header gives the title a band of its own.

gridkitStudio.diagram.vertexColor.markdownDescription: Blocks — Fill. Blocks while no field drives their color.. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.diagram.outlineColor.markdownDescription: Blocks — Outline color. Block and group outlines.. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.diagram.groupColor.markdownDescription: Blocks — Group fill. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.diagram.portSize.markdownDescription: Ports — Marker size. Port markers, arrowheads, and junctions. They scale with zoom.

gridkitStudio.diagram.portFontSize.markdownDescription: Ports — Name size. Port name size. It scales with zoom.

gridkitStudio.diagram.portSpacing.markdownDescription: Ports — Spacing. Distance between ports along a side.

gridkitStudio.diagram.edges.appearance.markdownDescription: Wires — Style. Tag draws named tags at the ends instead of a line.

gridkitStudio.diagram.edges.arrows.markdownDescription: Wires — Arrowheads. Mark where each signal arrives.

gridkitStudio.diagram.junctions.markdownDescription: Wires — Junctions. Dot where three or more wire segments meet.

gridkitStudio.diagram.edgeWidthPx.markdownDescription: Wires — Width. Wire width while no field drives it.

gridkitStudio.diagram.routeClearance.markdownDescription: Wires — Clearance. Gap wires keep from blocks.

gridkitStudio.diagram.edgeColor.markdownDescription: Wires — Color. Wires and ports while no field drives their color.. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.diagram.labels.visible.markdownDescription: Labels — Titles. Show block, wire and group titles.

gridkitStudio.diagram.fontSizePx.markdownDescription: Labels — Size. Title size. It scales with zoom.

gridkitStudio.diagram.labels.maxWidth.markdownDescription: Labels — Width. Widest a title runs before it wraps or ends.

gridkitStudio.diagram.textColor.markdownDescription: Labels — Color. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.diagram.layout.algorithm.markdownDescription: Layout — Layout. Manual keeps the positions the model gives.

gridkitStudio.diagram.layout.direction.markdownDescription: Layout — Direction. Where signals flow, rank to rank.

gridkitStudio.diagram.layout.vertexGap.markdownDescription: Layout — Block gap. Space between blocks in a rank.

gridkitStudio.diagram.layout.rankGap.markdownDescription: Layout — Rank gap. Space between ranks. It grows to fit wire titles.

gridkitStudio.diagram.layout.sweeps.markdownDescription: Layout — Crossing passes. Passes spent untangling wires.

gridkitStudio.diagram.hoverColor.markdownDescription: Highlight — Hover color. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.diagram.selectedColor.markdownDescription: Highlight — Selection color. Null follows the current VS Code theme.

gridkitStudio.diagram.animationMs.markdownDescription: Camera — Easing. Duration of camera and block moves.

gridkitStudio.diagram.fitPaddingPx.markdownDescription: Camera — Fit padding. Space kept around the diagram when it is fitted.

gridkitStudio.diagram.revealPaddingPx.markdownDescription: Camera — Reveal margin. How far inside the edge a located element must sit.

gridkitStudio.diagram.input.mode.markdownDescription: Interaction — Mode. Navigate moves the camera. Inspect only selects and opens menus.

gridkitStudio.diagram.input.wheel.markdownDescription: Interaction — Wheel zoom. When the wheel zooms the view.

gridkitStudio.diagram.input.keyboard.markdownDescription: Interaction — Keyboard. Pan, zoom, fit and step with the keys.

gridkitStudio.diagram.pickRadiusPx.markdownDescription: Interaction — Pick radius. How near the pointer must be to hover or select.

gridkitStudio.diagram.input.dragThreshol.markdownDescription: Interaction — Drag threshold. How far the mouse moves before a press becomes a drag.

gridkitStudio.diagram.input.touchDragThr.markdownDescription: Interaction — Touch drag threshold. How far a touch moves before it becomes a drag.

gridkitStudio.diagram.msaa.markdownDescription: Quality — Antialiasing. Every shape already smooths its own edges; multisampling adds only cost.

gridkitStudio.diagram.detail.markdownDescription: Quality — Detail. Auto fades ports and arrowheads out as the view zooms out.

gridkitStudio.diagram.hover.markdownDescription: Quality — Hover search. Auto pauses it while the view moves or runs slow.

gridkitStudio.diagram.hoverBudgetMs.markdownDescription: Quality — Hover budget. Time a hover search may take per frame.

gridkitStudio.diagram.animationMaxVertic.markdownDescription: Quality — Animation limit. Diagrams with more blocks than this skip animation.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Inspect the active open GridKit case, counts, schema and units. Read only.

languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read at most 100 rows and 32 KiB from the active open GridKit case. Read only.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read at most 100 rows and 32 KiB from the active open GridKit case. Read only.

languageModelTools.name: gridkit_read_diagnostics
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read current GridKit case diagnostics and revision. Read only.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read current GridKit case diagnostics and revision. Read only.

languageModelTools.name: gridkit_summarize_run
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the current and previous local GridKit simulation summaries. Read only.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read the current and previous local GridKit simulation summaries. Read only.

steps.title: Open a case
steps.description: [Open Case](command:gridkitStudio.openCase). Network and Diagram are document editors; Case and Monitor use the bottom panel.

steps.title: Inspect and edit
steps.description: Select an element and use Inspector or Case. Edits participate in native undo and redo.

steps.title: Run and plot
steps.description:
Check what to record in Monitored Signals, then Run in Simulation. The Monitor opens and plots the result automatically.
[Choose Monitored Signals](command:gridkitStudio.chooseSignals)
